submitted.rationale: La-Sb-O has a wide band gap, so under 2.4 eV illumination the whole line gives EQE near the noise floor. Index 14 (Sb 0.31) had the highest signal I measured at 0.0016%. Readings rose from Sb≈0.12 through 0.19 and 0.23 to 0.31, then fell to about zero at Sb 0.51. That puts any maximum roughly between Sb 0.25 and 0.45, near the La3SbO7-rich region.
